description: Complete Keelworks corpus inventory (shared + reference-only). corpus_role=shared samples are manifest entries (redistributable); corpus_role=reference samples are located + identity-verified but NOT redistributable, so they are never committed or synced. CGR identity was established on real material by P1-M1-T01 (2026-10-15); hash re-verification runs in tests/manifest_test.py whenever local copies are present.
